overview: You looked at the full moon in the almanac. Beside it were Tuesday's three burned sockets and Monday's sheet, still the night, with nothing added. You did not open a dawn.

parties.name: William Shakespeare
parties.context: Looked at the eighth in the almanac and left the sheet closed.

assets.name: the penny almanac
